description:
YITAMOTOR floor mats completely line the interior carpet to provide all-encompassing protection. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
For 2022-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee
Only fit 8 Passengers & Carpet Flooring
Features
Custom Fit: These floor mats are compatible with 2022-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee (NOT for WK or Grand Cherokee L), not for vehicles with vinyl floors; 3D laser scanning technology gives full protection to both the front and back, Please remove old floor mats before installing new ones.
Built For Durability: YITAMOTOR floor liners are compatible with 2022-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee (NOT for WK or Grand Cherokee L), made from premium TPE material featuring high tensity for great comfort and wear-resistance while remaining flexible and user-friendly even in extremely cold or hot environments; Product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVC.
All Season Protection & Non-Slip: Uniquely designed channels and raised edges can effectively trap liquid, debris, snow, mud, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean; Built-in retainer clips firmly grip the mat and prevent slipping when wet.
Easy To Clean: Simply shake the dirt out of the textured skid-resistant surface or spray down with a hose; No vacuuming or harsh chemicals are needed for maintenance.
Why Choose Yitamotor: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guards to your vehicle.
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.
